headline: Your notes in. A daily study plan out.
subhead: Add your exam dates and how long you can study each day. Autopilot plans every session until exam day.
caption:
Two exams in one week and no idea where to start? 📅

Tell Memora Autopilot when your exams are and how long you can actually study each day. It plans every session from now until exam day, mixing flashcards and quiz questions across both subjects, and keeps your rest days free.

Every topic shows what's secure, practised or not started yet, so you find the gaps before the exam does.

Plan your exams free. Link in bio.
